tablet_yuki: Assumed it stayed at desk_b1 during work hours. Actually found at kitchen_table_k1 multiple times (09:25, 13:43). Yuki likely moves it to the kitchen for meals or breaks. Check kitchen_table_k1 before assuming desk_b1.

mug_yuki: Assumed it remained at desk_b1. Actually found at kitchen_table_k1 (09:27) and later at coffee_table_l1 (22:13). The mug moves with Yuki’s location. Check kitchen_table_k1 during the day and coffee_table_l1 in the evening.

glass_yuki: Assumed it stayed at nightstand_b1 or moved to coffee_table_l1. Actually found at kitchen_table_k1 (13:43) and back at nightstand_b1 (22:46). It follows Yuki’s daily routine: kitchen during the day, bedroom at night. Check kitchen_table_k1 during the day, nightstand_b1 at night.

water_bottle_yuki: Assumed it was at coffee_table_l1. Actually found at kitchen_table_k1 (20:34). Yuki keeps it in the kitchen. Check kitchen_table_k1.

glass_nora: Assumed it stayed at nightstand_b2 or moved to kitchen_table_k1. Actually found at kitchen_table_k1 (20:41) and then cupboard_k1 (21:13). Nora puts it away in the cupboard after use. Check kitchen_table_k1 in the evening, cupboard_k1 late at night.

water_bottle_nora: Assumed it was at couch_l1 or kitchen_table_k1. Actually found at kitchen_table_k1 (20:43) and then dish_rack_k1 (21:13). Nora washes it and puts it in the dish rack. Check kitchen_table_k1 in the evening, dish_rack_k1 late at night.

book_nora: Assumed it stayed at nightstand_b2. Actually found at armchair_l1 (21:38). Nora reads in the living room. Check armchair_l1 or couch_l1 in the evening.
